working_definition: A 71-cell adult brain population co-expressing proctolin (Proc, a locomotor/muscle-modulating neuropeptide) and myosuppressin (Ms, an inhibitor of gut/heart motility and feeding modulator), recovered from the neuropeptide re-clustering in Davie et al. 2018. Unlike the other neuropeptide subclusters in this dataset, these 71 cells are scattered across more than 20 different res-2.0 parent clusters with no single cluster contributing more than ~17%, indicating this label reflects a co-expression signature detected across a heterogeneous mix of underlying transcriptomic states rather than cells drawn from one coherent parent population -- likely a co-expression remainder pooling several distinct Proc+ and/or Ms+ neuron types rather than a single established anatomical cell type.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A neuron expressing the neuropeptide Myosuppressin (Ms); there are several populations of these neurons in various locations of the larval and adult organism (Carlsson et al., 2010; Dickerson et al., 2012).

justification: Proc/Ms is one of the authors' named groups from the re-clustering of neuropeptide-expressing cells (Figure 2K), named for co-expression of Proctolin and Myosuppressin. FBbt has no proctolin-neuron class; its cells are Ms neurons (FBbt:00058028 'Ms neuron'; FBbt has only location-specific adult Ms cells, no general adult class). Broad match: the group is a subset of Ms neurons.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any peptidergic neuron of the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Common parent; the authors name the group for Ms (and Proc), and FBbt has a Ms neuron class.

recommendation: Broad match to FBbt:00058028 Ms neuron.
